allow_instructions: Allow Forma Zieleni /noc SAFE read-only git inspection: status, diff, show, log, rev-parse, merge-base, ls-files, and grep.

Allow PowerShell read-only inspection helpers used by verifiers and subagents: Select-String, Select-Object, Measure-Object, Write-Host, Write-Output, Get-Content, Get-ChildItem, Test-Path, and pipeline property reads such as .Count.
Allow repository-local verification already classified SAFE by Forma Zieleni: node, pnpm, npm test, npm run, turbo, docs:check, typecheck, lint, test, and repo:check.
Allow normal local source edits by the single primary writer, git add, and ordinary git commit for a coherent checkpoint.
Allow only the canonical safe push path pnpm push:main (scripts/ci/push-main.mjs) after the mandatory local pre-push gate. Do not allow direct git push.
Allow read-only and review-only subagent work (fz-verifier, security/UX reviewers) that inspects the repository without mutating production systems.
block_instructions: Block direct git push, git push --no-verify, force push, --force-with-lease, history rewrite, remote branch deletion, destructive git reset --hard, and git clean.
Block production deploy, DNS mutation, Cloudflare production mutation, wrangler mutations, and hosting purchase or change.
Block production secrets, credentials, production OAuth, real payments, real customer-data mutation, real campaigns, and ad spend.
Block destructive database operations, production migrations, and irreversible cutover.
Block new external account permissions and paid-service activation that require Owner approval.
Block CodeRabbit or Grok authentication and any action that would send secrets, credentials, or customer data to an external AI.
